paper_title: A New Quinoxaline and Isoindigo Based Polymer as Donor Material for Solar Cells: Role of Ecofriendly Processing Solvents on the Device Efficiency and Stability
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Journal of Polymer Science Part A  Polymer Chemistry - 2016 - Seri - A new quinoxaline and isoindigo based polymer as donor/auto/Journal of Polymer Science Part A  Polymer Chemistry - 2016 - Seri - A new quinoxaline and isoindigo based polymer as donor.md

knowledge_points.content: PBDTQx-ii is synthesized using a two-step approach: first, a Stille cross-coupling to form a complex monomer (Monomer A) containing benzodithiophene and fluorinated quinoxaline, followed by a Suzuki cross-coupling with an isoindigo-based borolane monomer.
knowledge_points.evidence: Briefly, the key monomer A was synthesized by a Stille cross-coupling reaction between 5,8-bis(5-bromothiophen-2- yl)-6,7-difluoro-2,3-bis(3-(octyloxy)phenyl)quinoxaline (1) and (4,8-bis(5-octylthiophen-2-yl)benzo[1,2-b:4,5-b'] dithiophene-2,6-diyl)bis(trimethylstannane) (2)... Next, Suzuki cross coupling reaction between monomer A and (E)-1,1'-bis(2-hexyldecyl)-6,6'-bis(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl1,3,2-dioxaborolan-2-yl)-3,3'-biindolinylidene-2,2'dione (3) gave the polymer P1.

knowledge_points.content: The polymer PBDTQx-ii exhibits a HOMO energy level of -5.87 eV and a LUMO energy level of -3.97 eV, with an optical bandgap of 1.63 eV in thin-film form.
knowledge_points.evidence: The resulting energy levels of P1 were calculated to be: HOMO = -5.87 eV and LUMO = -3.97 eV (Table 1)... thin film... Eg (eV) 1.63.

knowledge_points.content: The introduction of the isoindigo unit into the BDT-quinoxaline backbone lowers the LUMO energy by approximately 0.36 eV compared to the isoindigo-free reference polymer PFQBDT-TR, while having a negligible effect on the HOMO level.
knowledge_points.evidence: In comparison to the previously studied benzodithiophenequinoxaline based polymer PFQBDT-TR 10 (HOMO and LUMO energy levels of -5.89 and -3.61 eV, respectively) the polymer P1 exhibits a lower LUMO energy (ΔELUMO ~ 0.36 eV) highlighting the effect induced by the strong electron deficient isoindigo unit... the introduction of the isoindigo unit has an almost negligible impact on the HOMO energy [ΔEHOMO ~ 0.02 eV.]

knowledge_points.content: Inverted bulk heterojunction solar cells were fabricated with the architecture Glass/ITO/ZnO/P1:PC61BM/MoO3/Ag, achieving an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of up to 0.79 V.
knowledge_points.evidence: Device architecture is glass/ITO/ZnO/active layer/MoO3/Ag... while the values for the analogous system processed from o-xylene are Jsc = 8.9 mA/cm2 and Voc = 0.79 V.

knowledge_points.content: Processing the active layer from the non-chlorinated solvent o-xylene resulted in a 10% improvement in PCE (4.5%) compared to the chlorinated solvent o-DCB (4.0%), primarily due to an increase in short-circuit current density (Jsc).
knowledge_points.evidence: The use of o-xylene allows a ~10% improvement of the device efficiency in comparison to the analogous system processed from o-dichlorobenzene... the P1:PC61BM blend processed form o-DCB exhibits an average value of Jsc = 8.1 mA/cm2... while the values for the analogous system processed from o-xylene are Jsc = 8.9 mA/cm2.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized active layer thickness for PBDTQx-ii:PC61BM blends was higher when using o-xylene (90 nm) than when using o-DCB (75 nm), contributing to enhanced light harvesting.
knowledge_points.evidence: The improved light harvesting, further contributing to exciton and free charge generation, reflects the different thickness of the optimized blends (~75 and ~90 nm for o-DCB and o-xylene processed films, respectively, Table 2).

knowledge_points.content: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) revealed that o-xylene processed films have a slightly higher surface roughness (RMS ~1.7 nm) and more structured domains than o-DCB processed films (RMS ~1.2 nm), suggesting enhanced polymer aggregation or ordering.
knowledge_points.evidence: The topographic image of the blend processed from o-DCB [Fig. 3(A)] is characterized by a more regular and homogeneous surface... The same blend processed from o-xylene seems to show a relatively rougher surface [Fig. 3(B)] with fine and structured domains which might indicate a higher degree of polymer aggregation/ordering... (RMS ~ 1.2 nm and B) o-xylene:DIO 97:3 v/v (RMS ~ 1.7 nm).

knowledge_points.content: Devices processed from both o-xylene and o-DCB showed similar thermal stability, retaining approximately 76-80% of their initial power conversion efficiency after 100 hours of thermal stress at 85 °C in an inert atmosphere.
knowledge_points.evidence: After 100 h at 85 °C devices prepared from o-DCB and o-xylene showed a ~20 and ~24% reduction in PCE, respectively [Fig. 4(A)]... confirming the general and good morphological stability of P1-based devices able to retain ~80% of their initial performance after 4 days at 85 °C.

knowledge_points.content: The solar cells were fabricated using blade-coating in ambient air conditions, which is a scalable technique compatible with roll-to-roll manufacturing.
knowledge_points.evidence: Importantly, all photovoltaic devices were fabricated (except the top electrode) by blade-coating in air, which represents an easy, robust, reproducible and fully scalable approach to a roll-to-roll process.

knowledge_points.content: The best-performing P1:PC61BM solar cells processed from o-xylene achieved a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 4.7%.
